translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Yooseefo Biraa Wanc'c'aa
Yooseefo bare golle kaappuwaa, «Neeni ha asatuwaa ogoruu akiyaawaa keeshshaa katsaa unttunttoo kuntsaa; unttunttu ubbaa biraakka unttunttu ogoruwaa ogoruwaa doonaan wotsa;
yaataade wurssetsa teefaa ogoruwaa doonaan ta biraa wanc'c'aanne Aa katsaa biraa wotsa» yaagiide azazeedda; I Yooseefo geeddawaadan ootseedda.
Sa'ay wonttina he asatuu barenttu haretuwaa akkiidde baanaw moyzzeteeddino.

Unttunttu he katamaappe kesiide haakki beennan de'ishshin, Yooseefo bare golle kaappuwaa, «Dendda! Ha asatuwaa geeduwaa kaala; neeni unttuntta gakkeedda wode unttunttu, ‹Hintte ayaw keekaa iitan zaareedditee?
Hawe ta goday ushiyaanne k'ay s'uurabaa demmiyaa wanc'c'aa gidennee? Hawe hinttenttu ootseeddabay balabaa› yaaga» yaageedda.
I unttunttu geeduwaa gakkiide, ha geeddawaadankka unttunttoo odeedda.
Shin unttunttu, «Ta goday hawaa mala k'aalaa ayaw haasayii? Hewaa malaa ootsiyaawe nuuppe ne k'oomatuwaappe haakko!
Nuuni haray atto nu ogoruwaa doonaappe demmeedda biraa Kanaane biittaappe guyye new zaari aheeddo.
Ne godaa golliyaappe nuuni work'k'aa woy biraa wooti wuu'eetoo? Ne k'oomatuwaa giddon he wanc'c'ay beetteedda uray hayk'k'o; k'ay atteeda nuuni nu godaw ayile gidana» yaageeddino.
I unttuntta, «Hewaa gidooppe lo"a; hinttenttu geeddawaadan wanc'c'aa akkeedda ooninne ta ayile gidana; hinkko atteeda hinttenttu boriyaappe saro attana» yaageedda.
Hewaappe guyye, unttunttu ellekka barenttu ogoruwaa ogoruwaa sa'aan wotsiide billeeddino.
He kaappuu ubbaappe bayiratiyaawaa ogoruwaappe doommiide wurssetsa teefa gakkanaw koyeedda; he wanc'c'aa Biiniyaama ogoruwaa giddoppe demmeedda.
Hewaan unttunttu kayyotiide, barenttu mayuwaa peed'eeddino; barenttu ogoruwaa barenttu haretuwaan c'aaniide, guyye katamaa simmeeddino.
Yihuday bare ishatuwaanna Yooseefokko geliyaa wode, Yooseefo son de'ee; unttunttu Aa sintsan sa'aan guufanneeddino.
Yooseefo unttuntta, «hinttenttu ayaa iitabaa ootseeddite? Ta mala Asay s'uurabaa demmiyaawaa erikkiteeyye?» yaageedda.

Yihuday, «Ta godaw nuuni ayaa gaanee? Nuuni ayaa haasayanee? Woy nuuni s'illuwaa gidiyaawaa wooti bessanee? S'oossay ne ayiletuwaa bayzzuwaa k'onc'c'issi diggeedda. Simmi nuunikka he wanc'c'ay aappe beetteeddawekka ta godaw ayile gideedda» yaageedda.
Shin Yooseefo, «Hawaa malaa ootsiyaawe taappe haakko; ta wanc'c'ay aappe beetteedda bitaniyaa s'alalay ta ayile gidana. Hinkko hinttenttu hinttenttu aawuwaakko guyye saro simmite» yaageedda.
Yihuday aakko shiik'iide Aa, «Ta godaw, taani itti k'aalaa haasayana mala neena woossay; taana ne ayiliyaa hank'k'ettoppa; ayaw gooppe, neeni kaatiyaa mala.
Neeni ta goday nuuna ne ayiletuwaa, ‹Hinttenttoo aawuu de'iiyye woy ishay de'ii?› yaagaadde oochchaadda.
Nuunikka, ‹Nuw c'imeedda aawuu de'ee; I c'imi kichchiide yeleedda teefa na'aykka de'ee; he na'aa ishay hayk'k'eedda; bare aatiw itti Aa s'alalay atteedda; Aa aawuu Aa siik'ee› yaageedda.
«Neeni ne ayiletuwaa, ‹Taani Aa be'ana mala taw ahite› yaagaadda.
Nuuni ta godaa, ‹He na'ay bare aawuwaappe shaakettanaw danddayenna; shaakettooppe Aa aawuu hayk'k'anita› yaageedda.
Shin neeni ne ayiletuwaa, ‹Hintte teefa ishay hinttenana duge yaana d'ayooppe, laa"entsuwaa ta deemuwaa be'ikkita› yaagaadda.
Nuuni ne ayilatuu nu aawuwaakko simmiide beedda wode, ta goday geeddawaa aw odeeddo.
«Nu aawuu, ‹Guye biide amareeda katsaa woomite› yaagina,
nuuni Aa, ‹Nu teefa ishay nuunana booppe attin, duge baanaw danddayokko; ayaw gooppe, nu ishay teefay nuunana beennawaa gidooppe, nuuni he bitaniyaa deemuwaa be'anaw danddayokko› yaageeddo.
«Nu aawuu ne ayili nuuna, ‹Ta machata Raaheela taw laa"u attuma naanaa yeleeddawaa hinttenttu eriita;
unttunttuppe ittuu taappe shaakettiide biina, «Tumu Aa do'ay puuzereetsi meedda» yaagaad; hachche gakkanaw taani Aa be'abeykke.
Hawaa k'ay hinttenttu taappe shaakki afina, iitabay Aa gakkooppe, hinttenttu ta puuluntsaa huup'iyaa kayyuwaan duufuwaan yeggana› yaageedda.

«Hewaa diraw, ha"i taani guyye ne ayiliyaa ta aawuwaakko biyaa wode, ta aawuu, na'aa bare shemppuwaadan siik'iyaawe, na'ay nuunana baynnaawaa be'ooppe hayk'k'i aggana. Nuuni ne ayiletuu nu aawuwaa puuluntsaa huup'iyaa kayyuwaan duufuwaan yeggeetto.
Taani ne ayili na'aa ta waasetetsaan akkaad; taani Aa, ‹Ta aawoo, taani Aa new saro zaaraadde ahana d'ayooppe, ta de'uwaa ubbaan ne shek'ay taana gakko!› yaaga wotsaad.
«Yaateedda diraw, taani ne ayili ta godaw na'aa diraw ayiletaade, hawaan attina, na'ay bare ishatuwaanna guyye simmo.
Na'ay baynnan taani waanaade guyye ta aawuwaakko simmanee? tuytti, taana ta aawuu seelettana seelaa bessoppa» yaageedda.
